_meta.indication: Treatment of cystic fibrosis (CF) in patients aged 12 years and older who have at least one F508del mutation in the CFTR gene

pivotal_trials.design: Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, parallel-group, multicenter, 24-week treatment period
pivotal_trials.population: CF patients aged 12 years or older heterozygous for F508del and a second minimal function (MF) mutation
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Primary endpoint: absolute change in ppFEV1 from baseline at Week 4
pivotal_trials.result: LS mean treatment difference in change from baseline in ppFEV1 at Week 4 was 13.8% (95% CI 12.1, 15.4; p<0.0001) vs placebo

pivotal_trials.design: Randomized, double-blind, active-controlled (TEZ/IVA), parallel-group, multicenter; 4-week TEZ/IVA run-in then 4-week treatment period
pivotal_trials.population: CF patients aged 12 years or older homozygous for the F508del mutation (F/F genotype)
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Absolute change in ppFEV1 from baseline at Week 4
pivotal_trials.result: LS mean treatment difference in change from baseline in ppFEV1 at Week 4 was 10.0% (95% CI 7.4, 12.6; p<0.0001) vs TEZ/IVA

key_safety: Most common adverse drug reactions (≥5% and higher than placebo): headache (17% vs 15%), upper respiratory tract infection (16% vs 12%), abdominal pain (14% vs 9%), diarrhea (13% vs 7%), rash (10% vs 5%), and ALT increased (10% vs 3%); elevated liver function tests (ALT, AST, bilirubin) require monitoring
target_moa: Elexacaftor and tezacaftor bind different sites on CFTR to facilitate cellular processing and trafficking of F508del-CFTR (increasing CFTR at the cell surface); ivacaftor potentiates the channel gating (open probability) of CFTR at the cell surface
modality: Small molecule (oral fixed-dose combination of three CFTR modulators)
companion_dx_detail: If the patient's genotype is unknown, an FDA-cleared CF mutation test should be used to confirm the presence of at least one F508del mutation

advisory_committee.vote: No Advisory Committee meeting was held; given the persuasiveness of the clinical trial results, the Division decided discussion by an Advisory Committee was not necessary

description.text: Expanded indication to include patients aged 12 and older with a CFTR gene mutation responsive based on in vitro data

citations.quote: This Prior Approval supplemental new drug application proposes to expand the indication to include treatment of patients with cystic fibrosis who have a mutation in the cystic fibrosis transmembrane conductance regulator (CFTR) gene that is responsive to elexacafator/tezacafator/ivacafator based upon *in vitro* data. The revised indication is the treatment of cystic fibrosis in patients aged 12 years and older who have at least one F508del mutation in the cystic fibrosis transmembrane conductance regulator (CFTR) gene or a mutation in the CFTR gene that is responsive based on *in vitro* data.

description.text: Expanded to include pediatric cystic fibrosis patients aged 6 through 11 years with at least one F508del mutation or a mutation responsive based on in vitro data

citations.quote: This Prior Approval supplemental new drug application provides for the treatment of cystic fibrosis (CF) in patients aged 6 through 11 years old with at least one F508del mutation in the CFTR gene or a mutation in the CFTR gene that is responsive based on in vitro data.

description.text: Added additional responsive CFTR mutations to the indication for treatment of cystic fibrosis in patients aged 2 years and older

citations.quote: These Prior Approval supplemental new drug applications provide for the inclusion of additional mutations to the indication: treatment of cystic fibrosis in patients aged 2 years and older who have at least one F508del mutation in the CFTR gene or a mutation in the CFTR gene that is responsive based on clinical and/or in vitro data.

description.text: Expanded indication to include patients with at least one CFTR variant responsive based on clinical/in vitro data or producing CFTR protein, adding 265 ultra-rare CFTR variants

citations.quote: This Prior Approval supplemental new drug application provides for an expansion of the indication of Trikafta (ELX/TEZ/IVA) tablets and granules for the treatment of cystic fibrosis (CF) in adult and pediatric patients aged 2 years and older who have a clinical diagnosis of CF and who have at least one variant in the cystic fibrosis transmembrane conductance regulator (CFTR) gene that is either responsive based on clinical and/or in vitro data or results in production of CFTR protein. This indication expansion is based on 265 ultra-rare CFTR variants included in Section 12 of the Prescribing Information.

summary.text: This 505(b)(1) NDA for TRIKAFTA received Fast Track (2/8/2017), Breakthrough Therapy (5/15/2018), Orphan Drug (8/29/2018), and Priority Review (8/14/2019) designations, and was approved first cycle without an advisory committee meeting.

citations.quote: ELX/TEZ/IVA was granted Fast Track Designation on February 8, 2017, Breakthrough Therapy Designation on May 15, 2018, Orphan Drug Designation (ODD 18-6476) on August 29, 2018, and Priority Review designation on August 14, 2019.

This is a 505(b)(1) NDA for a triple combination therapy product containing elexacaftor (ELX), tezacaftor (TEZ), and ivacaftor (IVA) for the treatment of CF in patients 12 years of age and older who have at least one F508del mutation in the *CFTR* gene.
